Hi Samir — no worries, thanks for the update and hope your pipeline is stable. Happy to rebook. Sean (SE) and Laura (PM) are looped for tech/requirements context.

Quick options for a compact workshop (we can do remote demo + sandbox access):
- Today: 3:30–4:10pm PT (30–40m)
- Today: 5:00–5:40pm PT (30–40m) — later slot if you need time to clear the incident
- Mon 2026-11-16: 9:30–10:10am PT (30–40m)

Proposed agenda (compact):
1) 5 min — goals & current constraints (you)
2) 15 min — demo: model routing, KV/prefix cache behavior and live token accounting
3) 10 min — sandbox walkthrough with your sample workload (we'll pre-load a small dataset)
4) 10 min — Q&A + next steps (rollout options + Dedicated capacity sizing)

I'm attaching a short agenda and a sandbox invite stub so you can join immediately if a later slot works. If none of these fit, tell us a couple of times that do and we'll prioritize.

Marissa Cole
